'''Biabru''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]], she was part of [[Darth Marr]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] coalition along with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces under [[Satele Shan]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Agent Biabru appears as an Imperial Agent trainer in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
